candidates.description: This vector represents isolated Greek letters and phonetic consonant symbols used in linguistic or mathematical notation.
This feature vector activates on LaTeX formatting commands, mathematical symbols, and curly brace syntax used in document typesetting.
These tokens represent closing punctuation marks, brackets, and parentheses commonly found at the ends of code blocks or statements.
This feature vector activates strongly on the Thai consonant letter 'ม' (Mo Ma) and related sub-word tokens containing it.
This vector represents the Thai consonant character 'ต' (to tao) and its various character combinations.
This vector is related to mathematical and logical symbols used in formatted equations.
This vector activates on common mathematical operators and algebraic symbols used in equations.
This vector fires on proper nouns and multilingual name fragments, particularly historical and European names.
This feature vector activates strongly on LaTeX mathematical symbols, commands, and formatting tokens used for typesetting equations.
This vector represents punctuation marks and typographic symbols used in text processing.
